contexts.text: The spiritual Church, which is Carmel (or, fruitful field) ().
To pasture in Carmel and Bashan () = to be instructed in the goods of faith and charity.

Lebanon = the spiritual Church; Carmel and Sharon () = the celestial Church; of the latter is predicated the glory of Jehovah, when there is meant the celestial truth which is charity; of the former is predicated the honour of the God of Israel, when there is meant the spiritual good which also is charity.
Carmel () = the Church as to the Knowledges of good; in like manner Lebanon, and Hermon.
Carmel () = the spiritual Church, because there were vineyards there. AE 223:7.
The honour of Carmel and of Sharon () = the Divine good which they receive.
The good of the Church is meant by Carmel (); and the truths thence by vineyards, etc.
The top of Carmel () = all the truths of the Church... because in Carmel there were vineyards...
Carmel () = the spiritual Church which is in truths from good; its being a wilderness = that there were no truths from good there. AE 1100:13.
Lebanon = the Church as to the rational understanding of good and truth; Sharon, Bashan, and Carmel () = the Church as to the Knowledges of good and truth from the natural sense of the Word.

The glory of the forest, and Carmel, which the fire and the flame shall devour and consume () = the truth and the good of truth of the Church, which, being turned into falsities and evils of falsity, will be destroyed.
That the delight of spiritual and celestial love, which is the very joy of the heart, will perish, is signified by the gladness and joy from Carmel being gathered together.
